# Erode Genz Agri Expo 2027 — source record and website specification

Prepared 17 November 2026 from the 15 images supplied in chat, in their supplied order. This is a visual transcription and analysis, not independent confirmation of promotional claims. No original image binaries were supplied to the execution workspace. Original posters, native logos and the QR payload therefore are NOT backed up. Reconstructed PNG logos and new hero artwork are separately labelled and saved; they are not exact original logo backups.

## 01 — About us
Heading: ABOUT US.

“With creative ideas, careful planning, and professional management, we turn every event into a joyful and unforgettable experience. Our goal is to create beautiful memories that last a lifetime. With fresh ideas, innovative strategies, and a passion for excellence, we make every celebration special and memorable.”

Highlighted promise: “Creativity and flawless execution are our greatest strengths.”

“We help your business grow through smart marketing, creative promotions, and effective branding. Our goal is to increase brand awareness, attract more customers, and boost your business growth. With strategic marketing solutions, we connect your brand with potential customers and create new opportunities for long-term success.”

Three strengths: Creative Ideas; Precise Management; Business Growth.

Floating farm island includes green tractor, greenhouse, silo, drone spraying, solar panels, weather/sensor station, planted fields. ## 07 — Exhibition overview
“A grand agricultural exhibition that aims to fulfill the evolving needs of farmers by introducing advanced agricultural technologies, innovative solutions, and new business opportunities.”

Audience/participants: Vendors & Manufacturers; Banking Institutions; Traders & Experts; Entrepreneurs; Insurance Companies; Food Product & Processing Industries.

“The exhibition will showcase new products, services, and innovations, connecting manufacturers directly with farmers. It aims to create business opportunities, improve farming productivity, and make agriculture more profitable and sustainable.”

4 Days: Dec 31, 2026 – Jan 03, 2027. Venue: TEXVALLEY, PRICE-LESS MARKETPLACE.

“The exhibition is expected to attract farmers, entrepreneurs, business professionals, consumers, and students from across Tamil Nadu, especially from Erode, Tiruppur, Coimbatore, Karur, Namakkal, Salem, Dindigul, and Madurai.”

“As the first agricultural exhibition of 2027, ERODE GENZ AGRI EXPO 2027 aims to bring together farmers, technology providers, manufacturers, and businesses. The event will create new business opportunities, build strong industry connections, and support a more innovative, successful, and sustainable future for agriculture.” The ‘first’ statement is a brochure claim, not independently verified.

Visual: imaginative exhibition pavilion with green branded fascia, drone, tractor, produce, solar power, smart farming demo zone and tablet dashboard; overhead icons for crops, tractor, plant, communications, care/sustainability. This illustration suggests a visual theme, not a verified separate programme allocation.

## 08 — Day 1 and New Year star night
Day 1: December 31, 2026.

“The ERODE GENZ AGRI EXPO 2027 will be officially inaugurated in the presence of the Union Minister, State Ministers, and Members of the Legislative Assembly (MLAs). Following the inauguration, the dignitaries will visit all the exhibition stalls and participate in an interactive session with farmers arriving from across Tamil Nadu.” No names, official confirmations or opening time provided.

December 31 — NEW YEAR STAR NIGHT (8 PM TO 1 AM).
“To welcome the New Year 2027, a grand ‘WELCOME 27 – HAPPY NEW YEAR STAR NIGHT’ celebration will be held at Texvalley, Erode, from 8 PM to 1 AM.” This means 31 December 2026 20:00 to 1 January 2027 01:00 India time.

“FREE ENTRY PASSES will be provided to the public, allowing the people of Erode to celebrate the New Year with excitement and joy.” This free-entry statement is expressly attached to the Star Night; it does not establish free entry to all expo activities.

“The event will feature more than 20 celebrities from the film and television industries, including actors, actresses, directors, and music composers, making it a memorable New Year celebration for everyone.” No confirmed celebrity names or roster supplied; do not identify the illustrated faces as real scheduled attendees.

Visual: ribbon-cutting composite, busy exhibition entrance, fireworks, evening stage reading WELCOME 27 / HAPPY NEW YEAR / STAR NIGHT EVENT, drone and agricultural island.

## Cross-source audit and release requirements
1. Hall1 category counts/prices are complete. Keep map color and pricing tier as separate fields because ‘Silver’ in the map is not a Hall1 price tier.
2. Hall1 orange legend sizes do not reconcile (18 vs23). Pricing shows17 Star Prime orange stalls at10×16,3 Platinum orange stalls at10×15,3 Prime orange stalls at10×10; the last three conflict with ‘special size’ map color.
3. Hall2 map label198 is presumed149 for continuous enumeration, expressly flagged.
4. Hall2 color classes (orange13/yellow9) do not equal Golden21: Golden includes12 orange+9 yellow, while Star Gold173 is the remaining orange.
5. Dimensions have no explicit unit. Golden individual sizes except173 cannot be established per stall from the supplied legend alone.
6. Use planned-programme wording. No minister, celebrity or prize winner has been identified or confirmed by name.
7. Star Night free entry does not establish general expo admission. Daily expo opening/closing times are absent.
8. Animated 3D is a browser-rendered conceptual interpretation of the supplied maps. It is not a surveyed architectural model, live camera feed or real-time occupancy/availability system. No booth availability data source was provided.
9. Localize all textual page content and interactive controls in English, Tamil, Hindi, Malayalam, Kannada and Telugu. Keep official logo lettering unchanged. Store locale preference locally; set html lang; account for longer native-script text and number formatting.
10. Provide flat, selectable map fallback, keyboard-accessible stall directory, reduced-motion support, pause controls, touch controls and responsive layouts.
11. Exact source logo/poster backups remain pending original file upload. Reconstructed assets must never overwrite future originals. QR destination, aerial photographs, final dimension schedule, operating times and confirmations remain organiser inputs.

## Design / implementation direction
Forest green #064629; deep green #003b24; lime #9bce43; warm gold #e4b74f; pale blue #eaf3f7; white #fff.
Map blue #55bce5, orange #f59b23, yellow #f5e940; purple #5c338c. Keep these as source map semantics, regardless of price tier.
Express the poster's agricultural optimism through a cinematic farm hero, oversized editorial typography, leaf motifs, panoramic hall scene, subtle sun/particle movement, light/dark section rhythm and restrained gold details. Avoid presenting concept imagery as real venue photography.
3D: two separately selectable layouts with all193 stalls, lifts/toilet/stairs/LED/experience zones, stall-number labels, color legend, price/size details, search, category filters, orbit/zoom, automatic aisle tour, auto orbit, reset and 2D map. Animate aisle visitors and direction markers; honor reduced motion. Preserve relative stall placement and orientation; show schematic scale note.
Page narrative: event hero → facts/themes → event story/audience/geography → hall explorer → detailed tariff cards and stall lists → four-day programme → venue and practical information → organiser/services/partners → contact and source/asset notes.


## Hall explorer revision — 17 November 2026

The four re-supplied hall/layout and tariff references were rechecked. Nineteen directional lanes now replace artificial closed return loops: Hall1 centre south/down, side aisles up, top and lower-right cross aisles right; Hall2 outer-right up, top left, inner aisle down, lower cross aisle left, left-side aisle up, and the two cross lanes below the experience zones in opposite printed directions. The upper-left exit and lower-right entry in Hall2 remain open in the rendered perimeter. The small Hall1 staircase immediately above the toilet is restored. The first-floor approach is treated as a passage, not a blocked common-area box. All animated lane segments are checked against booth and facility rectangles. Avatars fade at lane ends; camera tour chapters transition overhead between lanes and do not imply an invented connecting walking route. Relative layout and dimension/source caveats still apply.

Selection now shares one state across the flat map and 3D model, with a highlighted open aisle side, number/price pin, native-language details, hover feedback, focus action, previous/next controls, keyboard spatial navigation, touch pan/pinch and motion controls. A Canvas2D orthographic 3D renderer provides full orbit, selection and animation when WebGL is unavailable.

## Pathway close-ups and booking states — 18 November 2026

Three new close-ups identify physical dividers that were missing from the schematic model. In Hall 1, the divider between top-row stalls 31 and 89 extends down to the 46/88 block and interrupts the top cross-aisle. As clarified by the organiser, the second divider is centred exactly between stalls 28 and 45, extending below their shared boundary; it is not on stall 45's outer edge. The westbound link stays to the left of this divider, and stall 45's east aisle remains open. In Hall 2, the LED/stall 173 boundary is separated from the aisle facing stalls 174 and 172; the vertical aisle stays open. These are rendered as low masonry barriers in all map views and included in collision audits. The top cross-aisle is split into two independent rightward lanes, giving 20 lanes in total. Walkers and arrows fade before blocked ends. Geometry remains schematic and is not a certified circulation plan.

Admin booking states are now Available, Reserved and Sold out. Existing Booked records retain their occupied meaning as Sold out. A sold-out stall triggers a notice and cannot become an enquiry selection; a reserved stall triggers a warning and its WhatsApp draft states that it is already reserved. Named status updates still require authenticated, revision-checked saves. No initial reservations or sales have been invented from these images.
